description: Match kick-off. No team or player.
Sampled pass. player=passer; related=receiver when COMPLETE. The log is a sample, not every pass.
Shot blocked before reaching the goal frame.
Shot on target that did not score; followed by a SAVE.
Shot that missed the goal frame.
Goalkeeper save. team=keeper's team; player=keeper; related=shooter (opposing).
Valid open-play or set-piece goal. related=assisting player when a preceding PASS event supports it.
Own goal. team/player=the culprit's side; credited_team_id=the opposing team, which receives the score.
Penalty awarded. team=awarded team; player=fouled player; related=fouling player (opposing).
Converted penalty. Changes the score.
Missed penalty. SAVED outcome is followed by a SAVE event.
Goal ruled out. Never changes the score. is_disallowed=true, is_goal=false.
Foul. team/player=offender; related=fouled player (opposing).
Caution shown to player.
Straight red card. Player cannot appear again and is not replaced.
Corner kick taken by player.
Offside called against player's team.
player=outgoing player; related=incoming player (same team).
End of first half after stoppage time.
Second half kicks off (same elapsed timestamp as HALF_TIME).
Final whistle after second-half stoppage time.
